name: @chestor/journal-ui
title: Journal
description: Journal page for Chestor Journal: what needs a person, what changed, and each item with its history.

wippy.description: Renders one Chestor Journal as a page: the items that need a person, the facts recorded since the reader last looked, the agents at work, and each item with its history. Pass the workspace component id through entry-id; mode preview stacks the page into one column for a side panel, full shows the list beside the open item. The component reads through the authenticated Journal API, refreshes on projection updates, consumes no slotted content, and surfaces missing ids or unavailable reads as explicit states.

entry-id.description: Workspace Journal component id to load; an empty value renders the required-id state without issuing API requests.

mode.description: Rendering context supplied by the workspace host: preview stacks the page into one column, full shows the list beside the open item.

read-only.description: Accepted for host compatibility; the page only reads.
